title: Resolve ecosystem entities and profiles from the selected installed store
goal: Resolve packaged default, explicit store, and layered user ecosystem entities and profiles without requiring a source checkout or configuration (landed in f87f1f9f3dfbc08c89b6a3b394d5786dfb74044e..d920c576fe8de45cd6fd64e8b4f9b816a90a0be3; tests/eco_cli.rs migrated to Commercial susi-ecosystem-hub in 0cd03651dc6e409d4ec560c5c810a7c5da4fd4e6, tests/eco_explain.rs migrated in 33fbae22bc57eba9762cffea2dd6d0bdaffd6590, and crates/susi-vendor-models/src/eco_* plus crates/susi-gemi/src/eco_compat_gate.rs moved out of Lean Core).
notes: Landed across f87f1f9f3dfbc08c89b6a3b394d5786dfb74044e..d920c576fe8de45cd6fd64e8b4f9b816a90a0be3. During Lean Core migration, tests/eco_cli.rs moved to Commercial susi-ecosystem-hub in 0cd03651dc6e409d4ec560c5c810a7c5da4fd4e6, tests/eco_explain.rs moved in 33fbae22bc57eba9762cffea2dd6d0bdaffd6590, and crates/susi-vendor-models/src/eco_* plus crates/susi-gemi/src/eco_compat_gate.rs moved out of Lean Core. In Core, src/cli/ecosystem_cli.rs has no inline unit tests and delegates to susi_gemi_models::eco_query and local_ecosystem, exercised at the Core boundary by plane_handler::tests::ecosystem_start_and_explain_validate_required_id_and_absolute_dir.

reuse.justification: Reused Core's ecosystem CLI dispatcher and open-core ecosystem query boundary while full graph/profile store coverage lives in Commercial susi-ecosystem-hub after Lean Core migration.
